status: prospective; run after clock-development-v1-p4 completes and before p7 games
question: How much hint traffic comes from prior requests, and how much does storage pressure suppress or replace useful information under the unchanged conservative key?
sample: First four games by frozen PGN schedule order of completed p4 development screen, independently of score. Use all legal prefixes from ply16 through min(59,last ply-1). Preserve original actual game sequence; no generated continuation or evaluation filters. Development replay, not independent strength evidence.
owners: Separate white/black private engine+TT across their actual alternating requests. Each configuration restarts from empty ownership. No history retained across requests.
observations: Read-only single-owner table representation counters and post-request occupancy, generation ages, same-key/collision refreshes, proof/depth rejects. Paired unobserved replay at every request/depth must match all semantic results and nodes; no timing inference. Include incomplete invocations without outcome labels.
validation: P3HintLifetimeStudyTest counters + cross-request observation parity; full per-request parity during experiment.
resource: One JVM, APC1, heap768MiB, BelowNormal; never concurrent with the clock screen.
limitations: Selected existing development game trajectories depend on candidate play. Small-table divergence is selective research evidence, not exact disagreement or an adoption recommendation. No memory/default change.
